entry.title: Research Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Hermes Agent v0.21.4 (v2026.9.21, released 21 September 2026) leads the cycle: a new --format stream-json CLI flag emits structured JSONL for machine-readable agent output, alongside skills auto-load and configurable MCP discovery concurrency in a 1,812-PR rollup — immediately useful for anyone scripting or integrating the agent. Two companion pieces document the Hermes Claude CLI subscription plugin: a pipeline deep-dive on how Hermes drives the unmodified official Claude Code executable with process isolation and billing relay, and an auth guide confirming credentials stay entirely inside the official CLI via claude auth login, so Hermes never handles API keys. Ecosystem coverage rounds out the section: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.19.0 (tagged 18 September 2026) emphasizes MCP security hardening with per-identity session scoping and adds vector-store connectors — relevant to agent builders evaluating adjacent SDKs — while AgentProto v0.20.0 (Apache-2.0, released 22 September 2026) launches as an open TypeScript runtime unifying 14 coding agents, notably listing Hermes among its supported integrations as a community signal.
